messages:
maria_sales: Heads up — Acme POC wants a 3yr commit with ~40% off. This currently trips CPQ limits. Need deal desk routing + quick SLA, timeline is tight (POC demo in 10 business days).

alex_dealdesk: Can you paste the ACV & seat counts? we need raw numbers for approval math.

maria_sales: ACV yr1 $1.2M, seats ramping, customer insists discount applied uniformly across term.

raj_sw: FYI if we accept 40% we must cap dedicated infra costs. CPQ currently routes when Discount__c > 25. We should consider term length too.

alex_dealdesk: Proposal — add Commit_Term_Months__c and change routing rule to consider both discount and term. Idea: IF(Discount__c > 30 OR Commit_Term_Months__c >= 24, route to dealdesk+legal+finance).

sarah_legal: Legal can fast-track provided SOW limits indemnity, no SLA-inflation, and we get securityQA answers. Need mark-to-market / repricing clause for market changes.

jordan_finance: Finance concern: 40% on a multi-year is material. We need a payment schedule (prefer front-loaded) and a reserve. Also want a 6mo performance review trigger.

alex_dealdesk: Can we set temporary SLA targets for this thread: dealdesk 24h, finance 48h, legal 72h? Sales needs a faster loop for POC.

maria_sales: Yes — please. If approvals slip past 72h I lose runway.

raj_sw: I'll add the CPQ fields to sandbox and update the routing rules. Proposed field list to add to Salesforce/CPQ: Commit_Term_Months__c, Commit_Level__c, Infrastructure_Reserve__c, Routing_Override__c. Example mapping snippet for the sandbox push:

```json
{
  "fields": [
    {"apiName": "Commit_Term_Months__c", "type": "number"},
    {"apiName": "Commit_Level__c", "type": "picklist", "values": ["standard","committed","enterprise"]},
    {"apiName": "Routing_Override__c", "type": "boolean"}
  ],
  "routingRule": "IF(Discount__c > 30 OR Commit_Term_Months__c >= 24, 'dealdesk;legal;finance', 'sales')"
}
```

ops-bot: deploy-bot: CPQ sandbox schema update deployed to `cpq-sandbox` at 2026-03-21T14:34:00Z.

alex_dealdesk: I'll create a temp tag `requires-committee` on the opp and notify #dealdesk-escalations. That triggers manual committee review while new routing rolls out.

maria_sales: Tag added and attachments uploaded (SOW draft, securityQA doc). @sarah_legal @jordan_finance @alex_dealdesk please review.

sarah_legal: Reviewing SOW now. Need clauses: data residency guarantees and audit rights; will send redlines within 48h, and draft mark-to-market language.

jordan_finance: Uploaded proposed payment schedule (50% year1 upfront, remainder quarterly). Finance can pre-approve conditional discount if termination recoup and audit clause present.

alex_dealdesk: Great — treating this as expedited. I'll set the SLA timers on the opp and keep it on manual watch. @maria_sales keep updates in opp comments. :thumbsup:

maria_sales: Thanks all — will push customer comms after legal/finance confirm. Will update thread as soon as I have the redlines/approval stamps.
